**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), confidence 0.95.**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** § 12.4 (p0046) — the only restriction binding Customer; § 12.3 (p0044) — an affirmative disclaimer that benefits us; plus searches for "compete", "exclusiv", field-of-use/territory language, which surfaced no other Customer-side covenant (the other "exclusive" hits concern licence grants, remedies and forum, not non-competes).
- **Why it fails:** § 12.4 imposes a term-plus-24-month, all-territory, undefined-scope non-compete on Customer that even bars acquisitions — walk-away territory, and it fails every fallback element (no named product, not term-only, tail over 12 months, no internal-development or acquisition carve-outs). It also contradicts § 12.3.
- **Cure (preferred level):** one surgical replace of the prohibitory operator in § 12.4, converting it to a confirmation that no such restriction applies; § 12.3 left untouched.
